title: CV / resume
examples: How many bullet points should I include?
What is the best way to format my contact details?
Does ATS mean I need to use fancy graphics?

explain.say: Your resume needs to show results, not just duties.
Use strong action verbs to start every bullet point.
Keep your formatting clean and professional looking.
Always save your final document as a PDF file.
Applicant Tracking Systems scan for keywords first.
In real life, writing a resume is like tailoring a suit.

faq.q: Should I include my GPA on my resume?
faq.a: It is generally best to omit your GPA unless you are a recent graduate and it is particularly high. You might also say you should leave out your GPA, or you could ask if GPA is necessary.
asks: Do I need to list my grades?

faq.q: How much detail should my bullet points have?
faq.a: Aim for one achievement per bullet point, keeping it concise but impactful. Try saying you should keep bullets short, or ask for bullet point length advice.
asks: Should my bullets be long paragraphs?
How many words per bullet point?

faq.q: What if the job description uses different terminology?
faq.a: You must mirror the language used in the job description using those exact keywords. This helps the ATS recognize your skills. You could also ask about keyword matching, or how to use industry jargon.
asks: Should I use the company's words?
How do I pass the ATS screening?

faq.q: Are fancy graphics okay on a resume?
faq.a: No, complex graphics or unusual layouts can confuse the ATS software. Stick to standard, clean formatting for maximum readability. You might also ask if graphics are okay, or about ATS compatibility.

faq.q: When should I update my resume?
faq.a: You should update your resume after every significant project or job role you complete. It is always good practice to keep it current. You could ask about update frequency, or when to revise it.
asks: How often should I revise it?
When is the best time to update my CV?

facts: Quantifying achievements with numbers provides concrete evidence of impact.
A clean, standard format is crucial for Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) to read correctly.
Action verbs should begin every bullet point to demonstrate initiative.
Always proofread your resume thoroughly for grammatical errors.

quiz.say: Instead of writing 'Was in charge of team meetings', which phrasing best shows impact?

options.show: Led weekly meetings, improving team efficiency by 15%.
options.say: Led weekly meetings, improving team efficiency by 15%.

quiz.why: This option starts with a strong action verb and includes a measurable result.

wrong.1: This is a passive statement that describes a duty, not an achievement.
wrong.2: This uses the passive voice and lacks any personal contribution or result.
wrong.3: This only states attendance and does not quantify any positive outcome.

quiz.say: If a job description emphasizes 'stakeholder communication', what should you do?

options.show: Only mention it if you have a specific example.
options.say: Only mention it if you have a specific example.

options.show: Use 'Stakeholder communication' in your own experience section.
options.say: Use 'Stakeholder communication' in your own experience section.

options.show: Ignore the term if it seems too advanced.
options.say: Ignore the term if it seems too advanced.

quiz.why: Matching the exact terminology helps the ATS score your application highly.

wrong.0: Even if you don't have a perfect example, mentioning related skills is better than nothing.
wrong.2: Synonyms might not be recognized by the specific ATS software used.
wrong.3: Ignoring key terms means the system might filter you out automatically.

quiz.say: Which formatting choice is safest for ATS compatibility?

options.show: Using a standard, single-column layout in a Word document.
options.say: Using a standard, single-column layout in a Word document.

options.show: Using tables or columns for layout.
options.say: Using tables or columns for layout.

quiz.why: Simple layouts are read sequentially by software, preventing data loss.

wrong.1: ATS often reads across columns incorrectly, scrambling your information.
wrong.2: Visual elements are often interpreted as junk data by the scanning software.
wrong.3: Uncommon fonts can cause the system to substitute characters incorrectly.
